findings.description: familyWalletKopecks was excluded from advanceOffsetKopecks (Tag 1215) in calculateSplitPaymentAllocation, causing family wallet balances not to be counted as advance offset.
findings.resolution: Included familyWalletKopecks in advanceOffsetKopecks and added comprehensive test case 5.

findings.description: PatientBillingModal hardcoded blank clinic requisites in actParams and omitted inn in patient prop interface, rendering empty clinic details on A4 act preview and blank patient INN in tax modal.
findings.resolution: Added patient.inn and clinic requisites props to PatientBillingModal, resolved via clinicProfile with canonical fallbacks (Mandate 8n), forwarded patient.inn and requisites to TaxDeductionCertificateModal.

findings.description: Act preview header displayed blank 'ИНН:  / КПП: ' and empty address when requisites were not provided.
findings.resolution: Provided graceful fallback formatting so preview displays valid clinic requisites.

findings.description: TaxDeductionCertificateModal had empty default clinic requisites and used raw window.print() which printed the entire CRM viewport.
findings.resolution: Added fallback resolution via appLogic.clinic and canonical defaults, replaced raw window.print() with hardwarePrinter.printHtmlWithPopupFallback in handlePrint, handlePrintBatch, and handlePrintBlank.

findings.description: Print buttons for Act (804n) and Tax Certificate (KND 1151156) called raw window.print() printing the viewport modal instead of standalone A4 documents.
findings.resolution: Implemented handlePrintAct and handlePrintTaxCertificate using generateCompletedActAndWarrantyHtml, renderOfficialTaxCertificateKnd1151156Html, and hardwarePrinter.printHtmlWithPopupFallback.
